title: CHS 103 - Community Health Science: Epidemiology, Disease Control and Environmental Health

items.q: Which term is described by “the study of how disease is distributed and what determines it in populations”?
o: Epidemic
Subclinical case
Incubation period
Epidemiology
items.s: Epidemiology is the study of how disease is distributed and what determines it in populations.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Tally sheet?
o: a form on which staff make a mark for each case seen
a living organism that carries a disease agent from one host to another
the examination of a water sample for organisms and harmful substances
the study of how disease is distributed and what determines it in populations
items.s: Tally sheet: a form on which staff make a mark for each case seen. The other options describe Vector, Epidemiology, Water quality test.

items.s: Open defecation: the practice of passing waste in the open instead of in a toilet. The other options describe Quarantine, Vector, Food handler.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Endemic?

items.s: Endemic: the constant presence of a disease at a usual level in a population. The other options describe Line listing, Pit latrine, Epidemic preparedness.

items.q: All of the following belong to Waste disposal and environmental sanitation EXCEPT
o: Sewage
Refuse
Borehole
Pit latrine

items.s: Residual spraying: the treatment of indoor surfaces that keeps killing insects for months. The other options describe Community register, Open defecation, Septic tank.

the first case of an outbreak to come to official attention
